title: Deeper/broader DXF ecosystem parser and route-lineage audit
mode: primary-source web research and local plan-inventory reconciliation
scope: Screen for separately implemented ASCII/Binary DXF parser and converter routes not already represented by the existing peer inventory
Separate a peer's direct DXF parser lineage from DWG conversion helpers that delegate to another codec
Refine the optional Binary-DXF and ACDSDATA comparator procedure without opening duplicate findings or mandatory validation work

method.limitations: The review used the published Go module documentation for kedazo/dxf-go v0.3.3 and mutable project source/README claims; no source archive or module checksum was fetched, no parser was run, and no ACDSDATA behavior was confirmed. The module page says v0.3.3 is not the latest version. Project-declared version coverage and raw unknown-entity retention are candidate-scope claims, not reproduced outcomes.

sources.revision: Published v0.3.3 module page dated 2026-10-01; documentation states it is not the latest module version
sources.observed: The README claims ASCII and Binary DXF read from R12 through AC1032; unsupported entity types are represented as UnknownEntity with raw group codes; selected OBJECTS including LAYOUT and IMAGEDEF are read; and the project is a fork of ixmilia/dxf-go. The README says DWG xrefs are converted using LibreDWG dwg2dxf before checking by the Go DXF parser.
sources.limits: Claims were not source-audited or executed. No evidence was found that the parser retains every modeler carrier chunk, parses ACDSDATA, resolves modern SAB keys to entity owners, or parses DWG independently.

sources.revision: Mutable master page reviewed 2026-10-20; repository showed one commit and no tagged release
sources.observed: The README describes a one-pass, zero-copy Binary-DXF scanner for R13+ that exposes typed entities and lookup indices. Its enumerated entity set includes 3DFACE, SPLINE, and HATCH but not 3DSOLID, REGION, or BODY; other entity types are represented as Entity::Unknown.
sources.limits: No source, binary, unknown-record path, OBJECTS handling, ACDSDATA handling, or terminal-EOF behavior was inspected or run. Treat only as a possible ordinary-entity Binary-DXF probe after commit pinning; not as a carrier or semantic parser.

sources.revision: Mutable master page reviewed 2026-10-20; repository showed one commit and no tagged release
sources.observed: The README describes a streaming text-DXF to Binary-DXF group-code/value transducer with typed sink callbacks and explicitly says it does not interpret drawing structure.
sources.limits: Not a parser, structural validator, or independent oracle; no build/run or group-code corpus audit was performed.

sources.revision: Mutable project README reviewed 2026-10-20; already represented in the parity inventory
sources.observed: The source describes a pre-alpha ODA-spec-derived DWG structural/entity reader with raw-object walking and versioned decoded/skipped/error reporting, but no DXF parser and no completed semantic ACIS path.
sources.limits: No new candidate or outcome was established in this pass; reported counters remain project/corpus-specific and were not reproduced.

sources.revision: Mutable project README reviewed 2026-10-20; already represented in the parity inventory
sources.observed: The project describes a narrow AC1024 2D writer and explicitly does not read DXF or support modeler geometry.
sources.limits: No additional comparator capability was found; it remains a test-design reference only.

decision.planDelta: Add kedazo/dxf-go v0.3.3 as an optional broad direct-DXF structural comparator after exact source/module pinning; classify its DWG helper path as LibreDWG-lineage. Keep xorgy/dxfscan as only a possible narrow ordinary-entity Binary-DXF probe pending source/EOF verification, and xorgy/dxfbin as a pair transducer rather than a parser/oracle. Any candidate must use a generated local input and prove complete parse before its scoped comparison; otherwise record NOT_QUALIFIED once and self-unblock. No new fixture, dependency, routine test, implementation blocker, or support promotion.

implementationReadyChecks: Pin exact Go module version, repository commit, module checksum, and toolchain; do not use a floating latest release.
Use only locally generated scratch DXF as the candidate input and require complete parse through EOF before comparing modeler data.
Check entity identity, all repeated group-310 chunks in order, reconstructed bytes, and any exposed ACDSDATA key/owner association; report fields not exposed as NOT_EXPOSED.
Keep direct DXF parser results separate from DWG input converted through LibreDWG dwg2dxf.
Treat UnknownEntity raw-group retention, declared version range, peer self-readback, and entity counts as structural diagnostics only—not carrier, semantic, or consumer proof.
If one exact generated profile cannot be qualified cheaply, record NOT_QUALIFIED once and continue the local ready queue without installing a dependency or running a full suite.
